# Summary

## GenAI today

- a complex operation that generates text (mostly)

- at the core, a neural net: a mesh of artificial neurons 
  
- neurons and connections are all *weighted*

-----

- the neural net *learns* but adjusting its weights to better capture the examples given to *train* it

- quantity and quality of the examples impact the weight thus the quality of the learning

- weights, as in 'open weights,' are the core of the core of GenAI systems


## Quantity

Perhaps surprisingly, weights are initialised to random values: 

it takes *extensive training* to adjust the weights towards a stable, effective set of values

The sheer amount of text that is used for learning is a huge factor but perhaps less important going forward


## Quality

The diversity of the text used in training is a huge factor

The intrinsic quality of a training text is often assessed using *information entropy*


## Information Entropy

Information entropy is a value between 0 and $\log n$.

Low entropy: text is deterministic: words/syntagmas are recurrent (ex.: Frankie Hi NRG) generation will be as non-diversified as the training

High entropy: all combinations come about, little learning as there is low discriminating value
